description: This file contains functions for generating and configuring radio and PHY settings for a software-defined radio system, including frequency calibration, ZMQ port extraction, and configuration population based on cell and RU configurations.

methods.name: generate_lower_phy_config
methods.description: Generates a lower PHY configuration based on cell and RU configurations, including frequency, timing, and buffer policies.

methods.name: split_rf_driver_args
methods.description: Splits a driver argument string by commas into a vector of strings.

methods.name: extract_zmq_ports
methods.description: Extracts ZMQ port addresses from driver argument strings based on a port identifier.

methods.name: calibrate_center_freq_Hz
methods.description: Calibrates a center frequency in Hz considering an offset and PPM calibration.

methods.name: generate_radio_config
methods.description: Populates radio configuration settings for each cell, including frequency, gain, and port arguments.

methods.name: generate_ru_sdr_config
methods.description: Creates a complete RU SDR configuration object based on given parameters and cell configurations.

methods.name: fill_sdr_worker_manager_config
methods.description: Fills worker manager configuration with RU SDR settings and cell affinities.
